head: LinkedIn business card: digital card with a QR code for your wallet
dek: LinkedIn's mobile app now lets you design a digital business card, add it to Apple Wallet or Google Wallet and swap it with someone by scanning a QR code. It's in English in the app for now.
details: You open it from the QR code on your profile, then change the layout, font, colours, pattern and add stickers or doodles on the back. Turning on auto-swap in Share settings exchanges both cards with one scan. Swapping cards doesn't send a connection request or a follow, and changes you make show up in other people's saved copies. LinkedIn says more devices and languages come later; neither source mentions a price.
where: LinkedIn app on iPhone and Android, in English
means: If you meet people at events, you can share your details with a scan instead of a paper card.
todo: In the app, tap your profile photo, then the QR code, then Edit; save the card and tap Add to Wallet.
